ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface; low-intensity black pixels occupy ~15% localized at the trailing edge, lateral tips, and median keel.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions cover the majority of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous jagged band along the trailing edge and lateral tips. A central vertical black column is visible at the median notch. Discrete black focal spots are observed in the lower-central region of the right lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~1:2 within its bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 3 to 18 pixels, with the most pronounced irregularities on the inner-half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; exhibiting concave curvature at the proximal region near the notch and transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of a cluster of approximately 6-8 circular raised textures (white-on-white) on the lower-mid section of the right lobe; small dark circular spots (mottling) visible near the upper-trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned dark linear disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the distal portion of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the lateral tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, high-contrast orange-red focal point is visible on the right lobe near the median notch boundary; irregular, deep notches on the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique upward-curling 'hook' morphology at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, outlined in high-contrast black pigmentation.
